bench_setup = function() {
  set.seed(20261117)
  n = 100L
  x = rnorm(n)
  t_event = exp(4 + 0.3 * x + 0.8 * rnorm(n))   # day-scale times, log mean ~ 4
  t_cens = exp(4.5 + 0.8 * rnorm(n))
  y = pmin(t_event, t_cens)
  dead = as.numeric(t_event <= t_cens)
  list(surv = survival::Surv(y, dead), x = x, dist = "lognormal")
}
notes: Times one lognormal AFT fit at n = 100 with one covariate (the KK21 per-covariate weight call) on day-scale times (log mean ~ 4, ~30% censored): current starts survreg from init = 0, candidate from survreg's default init then a mean-log-time start. Both converge to the same MLE under rel.tolerance 1e-9 with Newton steps, so coefficients should agree to ~1e-8; tol 1e-6 leaves margin. Lognormal is reached in KK21 only after the Weibull branch fails, and if init = 0 already succeeds first try the gain is only fewer Newton iterations.
